window: Editorial assessment 18 Nov 08:09–19 Nov 08:09 America/Chicago. Ukrainian Air Force overnight attack from 18 Nov 18:00 to 19 Nov 08:00 Kyiv; Russian MoD interceptions 18 Nov 20:00–19 Nov 08:00 Moscow. Distinct official windows; not synchronized 24-hour totals.
reporting_side: Ukrainian Air Force claims relayed by Ukrainska Pravda and Kyiv Independent; Russian Defense Ministry claims relayed by RIA Novosti/Sputnik and Rosbalt; regional civilian impact attributed to officials and separately reported by Reuters.
notes: PRELIMINARY AND ATTRIBUTED. Ukrainian Air Force reports 98 Russian drones (61 jet-powered), 69 neutralized/jammed (48 jet-powered), Oniks missiles with count not specified, and drone/missile hits at 18 locations as of 08:00 Kyiv; attack continuing at assessment. Russian MoD claims 53 Ukrainian fixed-wing UAVs intercepted 18 Nov 20:00–19 Nov 08:00 Moscow across ten regions; no independent verification. Regional-authority casualty roundup for past day: four killed, 36 injured across Ukraine (different window; not assigned exclusively to overnight drone attacks). Reuters reports attempted attack on Tatarstan oil facility and local officials say no casualties, damage from debris. Kerch rail bridge disruption reported 19 Nov, with precise strike mechanism not independently established. No verified aircraft losses, exact missile count, or comprehensive airspace closure status. Do not add separate windows or previous days' records.
